retake.waitBetweenAttempts: May retake; a knowledge test fee applies for each attempt

gdl.nightCurfew: No driving 1 a.m.-5 a.m. for the first 12 months (intermediate license), with exceptions
gdl.passengerLimits: First 6 months: no passengers under 20; next 6 months: no more than 3 under 20 (family exceptions apply)

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and date of birth
Proof of Social Security Number (or proof of ineligibility)
process.realIdNotes: Washington offers an Enhanced Driver License (EDL) and a standard license. A standard Washington license is not REAL ID-compliant; the EDL (proof of identity, U.S. citizenship, and Washington residence) satisfies federal air-travel requirements.
process.permitFee: $35 (first 1-year instruction permit; testing-provider fees may be additional)
process.visionStandard: 20/40 or better in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: No numeric point system; 6 moving violations in 12 months or 7 in 24 months triggers a 60-day suspension
facts.moveOverRule: Move over one lane or slow down for stopped emergency, tow, and roadside-assistance vehicles displaying flashing lights (RCW 46.61.212)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 20 mph when children are present or as posted
